title: Kizhakku Kadarkarai Salai
desc: Ganesh, a petrol station attendant, is irked by the arrogance of a rich girl. To teach her a lesson, he decides to make her fall for him, but her brother comes up with a devious plan to stop Ganesh.

title: Puriyatha Puthir
desc: Kathir and Meera's relationship is at stake when he starts receiving private videos of her from an anonymous blackmailer. Eventually, he is determined to get to the root of the issue.

title: Aalukkoru Aasai
desc: Arivazhagan plans on leading a happy life by choosing an independent educated girl as his partner. However, his orthodox grandparents trick him into marrying an illiterate woman.

title: Samudram
desc: Three brothers are ready to do anything for their sister. When she gets married to the son of a man seeking revenge on their family, the brothers lose their wealth and get humiliated at his hands.

title: Tamil Selvanum Thaniyar Anjalum
desc: Tamilselvan works as a courier boy to woo the woman he likes. Trouble ensues when a few criminals try to stop him from delivering a package containing incriminating evidence against them.

title: Senthooram
desc: Muthu is a village chief who adopts Rosa, an orphan, and raises her as his child. But unable to accept Rosa's choice of groom, Muthu tries to create problems between her and her husband, Kattaalai.

title: Sevarkodi
desc: Kali decides to get his sister Valli married off to the old Annachi because of his wealth. However, when Valli elopes with her lover, Bala, an infuriated Kali seeks revenge on them.

title: Fillers
desc: A comprehensive compilation of promotional videos and trailers of Bollywood movies featuring popular actors and actresses.

title: Ellaisamy
desc: A righteous village chieftain finds himself in a situation where a woman is assaulted. Will he resort to justice, or will he take matters into his own hands?
